name: gameplay-zoo-crocodile
origin: The Zoo crocodiles' first opening (checkpoint 5, feature motion), on the round of gameplay-zoo-start (seed 42, Arcade, Normal, robot 0; the AI robots stopped at the round's first frame, the player idle): Crocodile.runEngine counts 240 closed ticks, then gotoAndStop(2) with mouthOpen_mc at 1 (mouth-1), one mouth frame per tick to openComplete (25, open), held for 60 ticks while it eats (eating), one frame per tick to 46 (closing) and closed on frame 1 again (closed).
godot_note: Godot starts on the recorded round with the original's Math.random place (tests/goldens/gameplay-zoo-start/math_random.json); the crocodiles follow the simulation's crocodile frame (scripts/ui/game_board.gd).

actions.godot_note: The round this START opens takes its board and enemy robots from the golden of the zoo-start capture (App.round_as_recorded), as gameplay-cinema-start does.
AIControl.stop through the original's own method (fixture); Godot gives the robot no commands, as it then has none.
